name: Modifier Station observes stable native armor and kit input

steps._note: Prepared single-player or dedicated Purge Modifier Station with Hammer and Pliers. Enter from real station activation. On the same open screen use real drag/Shift-click to insert armor and kit. Verify Apply becomes visible and one Apply consumes one kit and yields one modified item. If using a different known item class, select the exact item from the actual UI tree.
